name: OEP Bridge Burning MCTS (purchase, combat move, non-combat move)
description: BB-MCTS of Justesen et al. (2018), i.e. the vanilla-mcts agent (UCT with C = 1/sqrt 2, epsilon-greedy rollouts with epsilon = 0.5 to the end of the turn, transposition table, descent-path BackupNegamax) plus bridge burning, searching the purchase, combat move and non-combat move: the time budget is split into burn phases, each ending by keeping only the most promising root child, which becomes the new root.
